description: TravelerFrame golden vectors — the shared seed for cross-language agreement (F#/C#/TS/Rust). A frame is a per-actor {actor: int64} map (the causal vector clock). transform(a,b) = pointwise MAX over the union of keys (the causal-join / LUB); dominates(a,b) = a ≥ b on every key of b (the semilattice order); converge = fold transform over a list of frames to the LUB (order-independent — the homeostat convergence).
